fixture.note: Same 500-pack fixture (seed 20261020) for both sides. Both apps list 492 mods: the 8 content/1142710 duplicate copies are enumerated by the legacy app and deduped, and are not enumerated by the new app.

environment.hostClass: GitHub-hosted windows-latest, runner image 20261018.275.1, 2 vCPU, 8 GiB
environment.hostComparability: Two ephemeral runner instances of the same CI host class and image, not one physical machine. Both sides ran on the identical image, CPU class, core count and RAM; repeated runs and the published distribution cover runner-to-runner variance. hostId names the host class, not a physical machine.

coldStartToInteractive.scope: Core pipeline only: process start to React mounted (legacy) / Session::initialize returned (new). WebView creation and first paint are excluded on both sides.

modLoad500.legacySource: docs/perf/legacy-baseline.json runs[].modListPopulatedMs minus 5000 ms Steam wait

adjustment.note: The legacy app waits up to 5000 ms for Steam workshop subscription ids on every run; docs/PERF.md subtracts the same fixed wait before comparing. Each legacy sample here is modListPopulatedMs - 5000, so the stored samples and stated median agree.

modLoad500.scope: Core pipeline only: process start to mod list populated (legacy) / first ModListSnapshot serialised for IPC (new). DOM render is excluded.

loadOrderApply.scope: Legacy includes CDP drag dispatch; the new app calls the core set_load_order command directly. The ratio covers the backend path only; UI interaction latency is not claimed.

profileSwitch.scope: Legacy includes CDP keyboard dispatch; the new app calls the core apply_profile command directly. The ratio covers the backend path only; UI interaction latency is not claimed.

launchHandoff.scope: Documented proxy on both sides. Legacy: DOM click to a stub Warhammer3.exe marker. New app: used_mods.txt write plus a stub process started by the harness, because the measured commit 428670c has no launch command (M3 adds it). Not a TW:WH3 launch.

notes: Every sample is copied from the two committed source reports; none is invented. Raw logs are in the rawLogs directories named on each side.
Medians are recomputed from the stored samples and match node scripts/qa/verify-perf-gate.mjs computeMedian exactly.
Legacy mod-load samples are modListPopulatedMs minus the fixed 5000 ms Steam wait, matching the documented docs/PERF.md treatment.

Same-host rule: both sides are release builds on two ephemeral GitHub windows-latest runner instances of the same class/image (2 vCPU, 8 GiB), recorded above. This is host-class comparability, not one physical machine.
The new-app launch row was measured on 428670c, before the M3 launch command existed; it is a harness proxy, not the app launch path.
